title: Mario's childhood sightings of craft

tellings.quote: I think about all the times I've ever from a boy when I've seen these things when I'm not them but their their craft.

plain: Air Force veteran Mario Woods, who says he was taken by beings as a young man, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he has seen their craft many times, going back to when he was a boy. He says he means the craft, not the beings themselves. If true, it would suggest his contact with them started long before his time in the military.
